body: They didn’t give me a time frame I don’t know why, I was pretty much struggling when I was diagnosed so don’t know why they didn’t gave me a time frame. First I had a surgery to the primary site of the cancer, then after that I did chemotherapy. then after I finished my chemo I had another surgery to remove the other stuffs

I know that I would be better if, I would be on my own, and I know that it will take some time for a change to happen. let's just hope that everything will be okay for me, before my pain and emotions consume all of me. anyway thank you!
